finalText:
Build's clean now — 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both in how bundler options get read:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler hands options as `retryCount`. That was `undefined`, so `.toFixed(0)` crashed the link step.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as an error. The new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`, so a normal "not set" case was throwing. Now `undefined` means backoff is off, same as before.

The rest was just deprecation noise from the bump (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, etc.) — left alone since fixing those isn't needed to unbreak the build.
